releaseNotes: Audited twenty follow-up sources, including ten outside the previous curated pack; seven passed, including five outside that pack.
Adds KuraManga, ManhwaDen, MangaRead.org, King of Shojo, LHTranslation, Mangasushi and GalaxyDegenScans to the existing nine-source beta.
Fixes King of Shojo chapter extraction and search; fixes repeated-first-page pagination in five WordPress sources.
KuraManga explicitly offers the first search batch only because the installed core cannot express its offset stride. Thirteen held sources remain outside verified delivery.
Existing source IDs, previous nine definitions and rollback artifacts are preserved. Canary only; physical-device acceptance is separate.
